name: LINTEC Co., Ltd.
india_angle: LINTEC invites collaboration and partnerships in India and beyond, aiming to pioneer new technological frontiers.
summary: LINTEC Co., Ltd. specializes in fluid control technologies crucial for semiconductor manufacturing, including mass flow controllers and liquid vaporization systems. Their products are integral to processes such as thin film deposition, and they are expanding their global footprint with a focus on partnerships in Asia and North America.
